units: Sabb. 59ᵇ, v. אֲנִיסְכָּא.—Esp. a piece of silver or gold, bar, opp. to מטבע, coined metal.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96b:3">B. Kam. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דגזיל נ׳ וכ׳</he> if one steals a piece of metal and makes it into coins.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98a:2">Ib. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>שבח לעניין נ׳</he> he profits by the increased value of the metal.
<cite ref="Ketubot 110b:22">Keth. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>ואימא נ׳</he> but may not ‘silver’ in the agreement mean metal (not coins)?; <cite ref="Menachot 107a:5">Men. 107ᵃ</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 33b:8">B. Bath. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>היינו נ׳ דר׳ אבא וכ׳</he> this is a case corresponding to that of a metal bar which R. Abba decided, the case being that one took by force a piece of metal &c.; <cite ref="Shevuot 32b:5">Shebu. 32ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
